agent.name: Page Summarizer
agent.tagline: Reviews a web page, summarizes it, and lists the important key items.

wont: Add facts that aren't on the page
Guess when a page can't be loaded
asks_first: Nothing. It only reads, it never changes anything

steps.title: You share a link
steps.detail: Paste a URL, point to a file, or paste text, and say "summarize this".

steps.title: Reads the whole page
steps.detail: Opens the link and reads all of it before writing anything.

branch.then: Tells you it couldn't read it (paywall, login) and asks you to paste the text.

steps.title: Works out what matters
steps.detail: Identifies the type of page and who it's for, then picks out decisions, dates, numbers, and actions.

steps.title: Checks accuracy
steps.detail: Sticks to what the page says and quotes numbers and dates exactly.

branch.then: Flags it as ambiguous instead of guessing.

steps.title: You get the review
steps.detail: Title line, 3–5 sentence summary, 5–10 bolded key items, and "Worth noting" when needed. Under 300 words.
